selected_evidence.requirement: VLAN 10/20 tagged trunk configured on shared link with node1 as router for both subnets
selected_evidence.summary: node1 eth1 (shared link) carries eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24) as router interfaces for VLAN10/VLAN20

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 placed in VLAN10 with its own subnet, reaches node1
selected_evidence.summary: node2 vlan10 sub-interface on enp8s0 gets 10.10.10.2/24 and successfully pings node1 at 10.10.10.1

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 placed in VLAN20 with its own subnet, reaches node1
selected_evidence.summary: node3 vlan20 sub-interface on enp8s0 gets 10.10.20.2/24 and successfully pings node1 at 10.10.20.1

selected_evidence.requirement: traffic between node2 and node3 (different VLANs) is refused
selected_evidence.summary: node2->node3 and node3->node2 pings fail with no route by default; when explicitly routed via node1, firewall REJECTs (Destination Port Unreachable) confirming active isolation, not just missing routes

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id c1b0817e...; issued backgrounded reboot with ack returned; connection dropped confirming disruption; polled until exec returned with new boot_id 76767044... and uptime ~12s; re-verified VLAN IPs, firewall zones, and bidirectional pings to node2/node3 all recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1e0cb179...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; connection timed out confirming disruption; new boot_id 63f1d89c... with uptime ~8s confirms restart; vlan10 config, reachability to node1, and isolation from node3 all recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c96a02ae...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; connection timed out confirming disruption; new boot_id a5127a39... with uptime ~7s confirms restart; vlan20 config, reachability to node1, and isolation from node2 all recovered
